sentences.zh: 開平二年正月癸酉，帝御金祥殿，受宰臣文武百官及諸籓屏陪臣稱賀，諸道貢舉一百五十七人，見於崇元門。

translations.literal: On guiyou in the first month of the second year of Kaiping, the Emperor took the throne at Jinxian Hall, received congratulations from chief ministers, civil and military officials of all ranks, and attendant envoys of the various circuits, and one hundred fifty-seven tribute graduates of the circuits were presented at Chongyuan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the first month of Kaiping 2 the Emperor presided at Jinxian Hall while chief ministers, the full civil and military establishment, and envoys from the circuits offered congratulations; one hundred fifty-seven circuit tribute graduates were presented at Chongyuan Gate.

sentences.zh: 封從子友甯為安王，友倫為密王。

translations.literal: He enfeoffed his nephew Youning as Prince of An and Youlun as Prince of Mi.
translations.idiomatic: He enfeoffed his nephews Youning as Prince of An and Youlun as Prince of Mi.

sentences.zh: 幽州劉守文進海東鷹鶻、蕃馬、氈罽、方物。

translations.literal: Liu Shouwen of Youzhou presented sea-eastern hawks and falcons, frontier horses, felt rugs, and local products.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shouwen of Youzhou sent sea-eastern hawks and falcons, frontier horses, felt rugs, and regional tribute.

sentences.zh: 自去冬少雪，春深農事方興，久無時雨。

translations.literal: Since the previous winter there had been little snow; when spring deepened and farming was underway, timely rain had long been absent.
translations.idiomatic: Snow had been scarce since the previous winter; with spring well advanced and the fields busy, timely rain still had not come.

sentences.zh: 兼慮有災疾，帝深軫下民，二月，命庶官遍祀於群望，掩瘞暴露，令近鎮案古法以禳祈，旬日乃雨。

translations.literal: The Emperor also feared pestilence and was deeply moved for the common people. In the second month he ordered officials of all ranks to sacrifice broadly at the territorial shrines, bury exposed corpses, and directed nearby commands to perform ancient rites of expiation; within ten days rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing disease as well, the Emperor grieved for the people. In the second month he ordered officials throughout the realm to sacrifice at the territorial shrines, bury the unburied dead, and had neighboring commands perform the old rites of expiation; rain came within ten days.

sentences.zh: 是月弑濟陰王。

translations.literal: That month the Prince of Jiyin was murdered.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Prince of Jiyin was murdered.

sentences.zh: 帝以上黨未收，因議撫巡，便往西都赴郊禋之禮。

translations.literal: Because Shangdang had not yet been recovered, the Emperor discussed a pacification tour and planned to go to the Western Capital for the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: With Shangdang still unconquered, he discussed a tour of the front and intended to go west for the suburban rites.

sentences.zh: 乃下令曉告中外，取三月一日離東京，以宰臣韓建權判建昌宮事，《五代會要》：十月，以尚書兵部侍郎李皎為建昌宮副使。

translations.literal: He then issued an edict to inform court and realm, setting the first day of the third month for departure from the Eastern Capital, with chief minister Han Jian acting as temporary administrator of Jianchang Palace. 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》: In the tenth month Li Jiao, vice minister of war, was made deputy administrator of Jianchang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed to court and realm that he would leave the Eastern Capital on the first day of the third month, with chief minister Han Jian acting administrator of Jianchang Palace. 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》 records that in the tenth month Li Jiao, vice minister of war, was made deputy administrator of Jianchang Palace.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎姚洎為鹵簿使，開封尹、博王友文為東都留守。

translations.literal: Vice minister of war Yao Ji was made master of regalia; the Prince of Bo, Youwen, as prefect of Kaifeng, was made eastern capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Ji, vice minister of war, was made master of regalia; the Prince of Bo, Youwen, prefect of Kaifeng, was named eastern capital regent.

sentences.zh: 辛未，契丹主安巴堅遣使貢良馬。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Khitan ruler Abaoji sent envoys presenting fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Khitan ruler Abaoji sent envoys with fine horses.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，帝親統六軍，巡幸澤、潞。

translations.literal: On renshen in the third month the Emperor personally led the Six Armies on a tour of Ze and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the third month the Emperor personally led the Six Armies to tour Ze and Lu.

sentences.zh: 是日寅時，車駕西幸，宰臣並要切司局皆扈從，晚次中牟。

translations.literal: That day at the yin hour the imperial carriage set out west; chief ministers and all critical bureaus accompanied; in the evening it halted at Zhongmou.
translations.idiomatic: That day at dawn the imperial train set out west, chief ministers and every critical bureau in attendance; by evening it halted at Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 下詔，以去年六月後，昭義行營陣歿都將吏卒死于王事，追念忠赤，乃錄其名氏，各下本軍，令給養妻孥，三年內官給糧賜。

translations.literal: An edict stated that after the sixth month of the previous year, commanders, officers, and soldiers of the Zhaoyi campaign army who had died in service—remembering their loyalty—should have their names recorded and sent to their original armies to provide for wives and children, with grain and stipends from the state for three years.
translations.idiomatic: An edict recalled that since the sixth month of the previous year, officers and men of the Zhaoyi campaign who had fallen in service should have their names recorded and sent to their home armies so wives and children would be provided for, with state grain and stipends for three years.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸澤州。

translations.literal: On dingchou he reached Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he reached Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以同州節度使劉知俊為潞州行營招討使。

translations.literal: On xinsi Liu Zhijun, military governor of Tongzhou, was made pacification commissioner of the Lu Prefecture campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Liu Zhijun, military governor of Tongzhou, was appointed pacification commissioner for the Lu campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬午，宴扈駕群臣並勞知俊，賜以金帶、戰袍、寶劍、茶藥。

translations.literal: On renchen he feasted the accompanying ministers and rewarded Zhijun, bestowing gold belts, battle robes, treasured swords, tea, and medicines.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he feasted the accompanying officials and honored Zhijun with gold belts, battle robes, treasured swords, tea, and medicines.

sentences.zh: 甲申，登東北隅逍遙樓搜閱騎乘，旌甲滿野。

translations.literal: On jiashen he ascended the Leisure Tower in the northeast corner to review cavalry and horses; banners and armor covered the fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he climbed the Leisure Tower in the northeast corner to review horse and rider; banners and armor filled the plain.

sentences.zh: 丙申，招討使劉知俊上章請車駕還東京，蓋小郡湫隘，非久駐蹕之所。

translations.literal: On bingshen pacification commissioner Liu Zhijun submitted a memorial asking the imperial carriage to return to the Eastern Capital, saying the small prefecture was cramped and not a place for long encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Liu Zhijun, pacification commissioner, memorialized that the Emperor should return to the Eastern Capital—the prefecture was too small and cramped for a prolonged stay.

sentences.zh: 達覽，帝俞其請。

translations.literal: When it reached him, the Emperor approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 以鴻臚卿李肼唐室宗屬，封萊國公，為二王后。

translations.literal: Because Director of Banquets Li Pin was of Tang imperial lineage, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Lai and made one of the two former dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Li Pin of the Banquets Office, being of Tang imperial blood, was enfeoffed Duke of Lai and installed as one of the two former dynasties.

sentences.zh: 有司奏：「萊國公李肼合留三廟，於西都選地位建立廟宇，以備四仲祀祭，命度支供給，以遵彝典。」

translations.literal: The relevant offices memorialized: "Duke of Lai Li Pin should retain three ancestral temples; at the Western Capital select a site to establish temple buildings for the four seasonal sacrifices, with the Department of Revenue supplying expenses, in accord with canonical precedent."
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices reported that Duke of Lai Li Pin should keep three temples; at the Western Capital a site was to be chosen for temple buildings for the four seasonal sacrifices, with the Department of Revenue supplying costs according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 四月，以吏部侍郎于兢為中書侍郎、平章事，以翰林奉旨學士張策為刑部侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Yu Jing, vice minister of personnel, was made vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor; Zhang Ce, Hanlin academician recipient of edicts, was made vice minister of justice and chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Yu Jing, vice minister of personnel, became vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor; Zhang Ce, Hanlin academician recipient of edicts, became vice minister of justice and chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 時帝在澤州，拜二相於行在。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor was at Ze Prefecture and invested the two chancellors at the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was then at Ze Prefecture and invested the two chancellors at the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕離澤州。

translations.literal: On bingwu the imperial carriage left Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the imperial train left Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，駐蹕於懷州，宴宰臣文武百官。

translations.literal: On dingwei it encamped at Huai Prefecture and feasted chief ministers and civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei it halted at Huai Prefecture and feasted chief ministers and the full establishment.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，至鄭州。

translations.literal: On xinhai it reached Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai it reached Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬子，至東京。

translations.literal: On renzi it reached the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi it reached the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車駕幸繁台觀稼。

translations.literal: On bingyin the imperial carriage visited Fantai to inspect the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Emperor visited Fantai to inspect the crops.

sentences.zh: 鄢陵居人程震以兩歧麥穗並畫圖來進。

translations.literal: Cheng Zhen, a resident of Yanling, presented double-eared wheat ears and also submitted a painted illustration.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhen of Yanling presented double-eared wheat and submitted a painted illustration.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，淮寇侵軼潭、嶽邊境，欲援朗州，以戰艦百餘艘揚帆西上，泊鼎口。

translations.literal: On jiayin Huai bandits raided the borders of Tan and Yue, intending to aid Lang Prefecture; more than a hundred warships set sail west and anchored at Dingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Huai rebels raided Tan and Yue, aiming to relieve Lang Prefecture; over a hundred warships sailed west and anchored at Dingkou.

sentences.zh: 湖南馬殷遣水軍都將黃瑀率樓船遮擊之，賊眾沿流宵遁，追至鹿角鎮。

translations.literal: Ma Yin of Hunan sent naval commander Huang Yu with tower ships to intercept; the rebels fled by night downriver and were pursued to Lujiao Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yin of Hunan sent naval commander Huang Yu with tower ships to intercept them; the rebels fled downstream by night and were pursued to Lujiao Fort.

sentences.zh: 詔以戶部尚書致仕裴迪復為右僕射。

translations.literal: An edict recalled Pei Di, retired minister of revenue, to the post of right vice director of the Department of State.
translations.idiomatic: An edict recalled Pei Di, retired minister of revenue, as right vice director of the Department of State.

sentences.zh: 迪敏事慎言，達吏治，明籌算。

translations.literal: Di was attentive in affairs and cautious in speech, versed in administration, and skilled in reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: Di was diligent and discreet, expert in administration, and skilled at accounts.

sentences.zh: 帝初建節旄於夷門，迪一謁見如故知，乃辟為從事。

translations.literal: When the Emperor first established his command at Yimen, Di paid one visit and was received as an old acquaintance, and was recruited as a staff officer.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor first raised his banner at Yimen, Di called once and was welcomed like an old friend, then taken on as staff officer.

sentences.zh: 自是之後，曆三十年，委四鎮租賦、兵籍、帑廩、官吏、獄訟、賞罰、經費、運漕，事無巨細，皆得專之。

translations.literal: From then for thirty years he was entrusted with the tax revenues, military registers, treasuries, officials, lawsuits, rewards and punishments, expenses, and transport of four circuits—nothing great or small in which he did not have sole charge.
translations.idiomatic: For thirty years thereafter he held sole charge of the tax rolls, military registers, treasuries, officials, lawsuits, rewards and punishments, expenses, and transport of four circuits—nothing large or small escaped him.

sentences.zh: 帝每出師，即知軍州事，逮于二紀，不出梁之闉閎，甚有裨贊之道。

translations.literal: Whenever the Emperor took the field, Di knew military and prefectural affairs; for two reign periods he did not leave Liang's inner precincts, and was of great help in counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the Emperor campaigned, Di handled military and civil affairs; for two reigns he scarcely left the inner city of Liang, and his counsel proved invaluable.

sentences.zh: 禪代之歲，命為太常卿，屬年已耆耄，視聽昏塞，不任朝謁。

translations.literal: In the year of the abdication he was appointed minister of sacrifices; by then he was aged, his sight and hearing dim, and he could not attend court.
translations.idiomatic: In the year of the transfer of the mandate he was made minister of sacrifices; by then he was old, his sight and hearing failing, and unfit for court.

sentences.zh: 遂請老，許之。

translations.literal: He then requested retirement and was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to retire and was allowed.

sentences.zh: 期月復起，師長庶官焉。

translations.literal: A month later he was recalled to head the civil officials.
translations.idiomatic: A month later he was recalled to head the civil service.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，王師圍潞州將及二年，李進通危在旦夕，不俟攻擊，當自降。

translations.literal: On dingchou in the fifth month the imperial army had besieged Lu Prefecture for nearly two years; Li Jintong was at death's door and would surely surrender without an assault.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the fifth month the imperial army had besieged Lu Prefecture for nearly two years; Li Jintong was at the end of his rope and would surely surrender without a storm.

sentences.zh: 太原李存勖以厚幣誘結北蕃諸部，並其境內丁壯，悉驅南征決戰，以救上黨之急。

translations.literal: Li Cunxu of Taiyuan used rich gifts to win over the northern tribes and drove all able men within his borders south for a decisive battle to relieve the crisis at Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cunxu of Taiyuan bought off the northern tribes with rich gifts and drove every able man in his realm south for a decisive battle to break the siege of Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 部落帳族，馳馬勵兵，數路齊進，於銅鞮樹寨，旗壘相望。

translations.literal: Tribal chiefs and clan leaders spurred horses and sharpened weapons; several columns advanced together; at Tongdi they pitched camps, banners and ramparts in sight of one another.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal chiefs and clan leaders spurred their horses and sharpened arms; several columns advanced together; at Tongdi they pitched camp after camp, banners and walls in sight of one another.

sentences.zh: 王師敗於潞州。

translations.literal: The imperial army was defeated at Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial army was defeated at Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己丑，令下諸州，去年有蝗蟲下子處，蓋前冬無雪，今春亢陽，致為災沴，實傷壟畝。

translations.literal: On jichou an order went to all prefectures: where locusts had laid eggs the previous year, the lack of snow the previous winter and the drought this spring had produced disaster and truly harmed the fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou orders went to every prefecture: where locusts had laid eggs the year before, the snowless winter and spring drought had bred disaster and ravaged the fields.

sentences.zh: 必慮今秋重困稼穡，自知多在荒陂榛蕪之內，所在長吏各須分配地界，精加翦撲，以絕根本。

translations.literal: Fearing a worse blow to the harvest in autumn, knowing the eggs mostly lay in overgrown waste ground, local magistrates were each to mark boundaries and cut and burn thoroughly to destroy the root.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing worse harm in autumn, and knowing the eggs lay chiefly in overgrown wasteland, each local magistrate was to mark boundaries and cut and burn thoroughly to destroy them at the root.

sentences.zh: 壬辰夜，火星犯月。

translations.literal: On renchen night Mars invaded the moon.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen night Mars crossed the moon.

sentences.zh: 太史奏，災合在荊楚。

translations.literal: The astrologers reported that the disaster would fall on Jing and Chu.
translations.idiomatic: The astrologers reported the omen would strike Jing and Chu.

sentences.zh: 乃令設武備，寬刑罰，恤人禁暴以禳之。

translations.literal: The Emperor then ordered military preparations, eased punishments, and showed mercy to the people and forbade violence to expiate it.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered military readiness, lighter punishments, mercy for the people, and an end to violence to avert the omen.

sentences.zh: 軍前行營都將康懷英、孫海金以下主將四十三人，於右銀台門進狀待罪。

translations.literal: Kang Huaiying, Sun Haijin, and forty-one other commanders of the forward campaign army and below submitted memorials of guilt at the Right Silver Terrace Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Huaiying, Sun Haijin, and forty-one other forward commanders submitted memorials accepting blame at the Right Silver Terrace Gate.

sentences.zh: 帝以去年發軍之日不利，有違兵法，並釋放，兼各賜分物酒食勞問。

translations.literal: The Emperor held that the day of dispatch the previous year had been inauspicious and violated military law; he released them all and moreover bestowed gifts of provisions, wine, and food in consolation.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor held that the day of dispatch the year before had been ill-chosen and against military law; he released them all and gave each gifts of provisions, wine, and food in consolation.

sentences.zh: 制：義昌軍節度使劉守文加中書令，封大彭王；

translations.literal: An edict: Liu Shouwen, military governor of Yichang, was promoted to chief councilor and enfeoffed as King of Dapeng;
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted Liu Shouwen, military governor of Yichang, to chief councilor and enfeoffed him King of Dapeng;

sentences.zh: 盧龍軍節度使劉守光封河間郡王；

translations.literal: Liu Shouguang, military governor of Lulong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Hejian;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shouguang, military governor of Lulong, was enfeoffed Prince of Hejian;

sentences.zh: 許州節度使馮行襲封長樂王。

translations.literal: Feng Xingxi, military governor of Xuzhou, was enfeoffed as Prince of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Xingxi, military governor of Xuzhou, was enfeoffed Prince of Changle.

sentences.zh: 是月癸未，淮賊寇荊州石首縣，襄陽舉舟師沿瀺港襲敗之。

translations.literal: That month on guiwei Huai bandits raided Shishou County in Jing Prefecture; Xiangyang sent river forces along Chan Harbor to attack and defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: That month on guiwei Huai rebels raided Shishou in Jing Prefecture; Xiangyang sent river forces up Chan Harbor and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，以亢陽，慮時政之闕，乃詔曰：「邇者下民喪禮，法吏舞文，銓衡既失於選求，州鎮又無其舉刺，風俗未厚，獄訟實繁，職此之由，上遭天譴。

translations.literal: On xinhai in the sixth month, because of drought, fearing faults in current policy, an edict said: "Of late the people have lost proper mourning rites, legal officers twist the statutes, selection has failed in appointments, and prefectures and commands no longer investigate and impeach; customs are not thick, lawsuits are truly numerous—this is why Heaven has rebuked us."
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the sixth month, with drought persisting and fearing flaws in governance, an edict declared: "Lately the people neglect mourning, clerks twist the law, appointments fail in selection, and circuits no longer investigate wrongdoing; customs are thin and lawsuits abound—for this Heaven rebukes us."

sentences.zh: 」至是，決遣囚徒及戒勵中外。

translations.literal: Thereupon prisoners were judged and released and court and realm were admonished.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners were then judged and released, and court and realm were admonished.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，月犯角宿。

translations.literal: On bingyin the moon invaded the Horn mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the moon crossed the Horn mansion.

sentences.zh: 帝以其分野在兗州，乃令長吏治戎事，設武備，省獄訟，恤疲病，祈福禳災，以順天戒。

translations.literal: The Emperor held that his allotted region was Yan Prefecture and ordered local magistrates to ready military affairs, set defenses, reduce lawsuits, succor the weary and sick, and pray and expiate disaster to accord with Heaven's warning.
translations.idiomatic: His allotted region being Yan Prefecture, he ordered local magistrates to ready arms, strengthen defenses, lighten lawsuits, succor the sick, and pray and expiate to heed Heaven's warning.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，邠、岐來寇，雍西編戶困於逃避，且芟害禾稼，結營自固。

translations.literal: On bingchen Bin and Qi came raiding; the registered households of western Yong were harried in flight, and their crops were cut down as they fortified camps.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Bin and Qi raided; registered households in western Yong were harried in flight while crops were cut and camps fortified.

sentences.zh: 逾月，同州劉知俊領所部兵擊退，襲至幕穀，大破之，俘斬千計，收其器甲，宋文通僅以身免。

translations.literal: After more than a month Liu Zhijun of Tongzhou led his troops to beat them back, struck to Mugou, and routed them; a thousand or more were captured or slain, their weapons and armor taken; Song Wentong barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month Liu Zhijun of Tongzhou led his troops to drive them off, struck to Mugou, and routed them; over a thousand were captured or killed and their arms taken; Song Wentong barely escaped.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「敦尚儉素，抑有前聞，斥去浮華，期臻至理。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Honoring thrift and simplicity has precedent of old; driving out extravagance aims at supreme principle."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Thrift and simplicity have long been honored; driving out extravagance is the path to good order."

sentences.zh: 如聞近日貢奉，競務奢淫，或奇巧蕩心，或雕鐫溢目，徒殫資用，有費工庸。

translations.literal: It was heard that recently tribute strove for luxury—either curious novelties to unsettle the heart or carving and inlay to dazzle the eye, wasting resources and labor.
translations.idiomatic: It was reported that recent tribute competed in luxury—curios to unsettle the mind or carving and inlay to dazzle the eye—wasting wealth and labor.

sentences.zh: 此後應諸道進獻，不得以金寶裝飾戈甲劍戟。

translations.literal: Henceforth all circuit presentations must not use gold or jewels to decorate spears, halberds, swords, or ji.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth no circuit might present spears, halberds, swords, or ji decorated with gold or jewels.

sentences.zh: 至於鞍勒，不用塗金及雕刻龍鳳。

translations.literal: As for saddles and bridles, gilding and carving of dragons and phoenixes were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Saddles and bridles might not be gilded or carved with dragons and phoenixes.

sentences.zh: 如有此色，所司不得引進。

translations.literal: If such appeared, the relevant offices must not admit them.
translations.idiomatic: Such items were not to be received.

sentences.zh: 」邕州奏，鏌鎁山僧法通、道璘有道行，冬賜紫衣。

translations.literal: Yong Prefecture reported that the monks Fatong and Daolin of Moye Mountain had the Way; in winter they were granted purple robes.
translations.idiomatic: Yong Prefecture reported that monks Fatong and Daolin of Moye Mountain possessed the Way; in winter they were granted purple robes.

sentences.zh: 是月壬戌，岳州為淮賊所據。

translations.literal: That month on renxu Yue Prefecture was taken by Huai bandits.
translations.idiomatic: That month on renxu Yue Prefecture fell to Huai rebels.

sentences.zh: 帝以此郡五嶺、三湘水陸會合之地，委輸商賈，靡不由斯，遂令荊湘湖南北舉舟師同力致討。

translations.literal: Because this command was where the Five Ridges and the three Xiang rivers met by land and water, and merchant transport all passed through it, the Emperor ordered the Hunan and Hubei commands of Jing and Xiang to raise river forces together to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Because the command lay where the Five Ridges and the three Xiang met by land and water and all merchant traffic passed, he ordered the Hunan and Hubei commands of Jing and Xiang to raise river forces for a joint attack.

sentences.zh: 王師既集，淮夷毀壁焚郭而遁。

translations.literal: When the imperial army assembled, the Huai rebels destroyed their walls, burned their suburbs, and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army gathered, the Huai rebels tore down their walls, burned the suburbs, and fled.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，大霖雨，陂澤泛溢，頗傷稼穡，帝幸右天武軍河亭觀水；

translations.literal: On jiaxu in the seventh month of autumn great rains fell, marshes and lakes overflowed, and crops were much harmed; the Emperor visited the river pavilion of the Right Heavenly Martial Army to view the waters;
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the seventh month heavy rains flooded marshes and lakes and damaged the crops; the Emperor visited the river pavilion of the Right Heavenly Martial Army to view the flood;

sentences.zh: 幸高僧台閱禁衛六軍。

translations.literal: he visited Gaoseng Terrace to review the palace guard Six Armies.
translations.idiomatic: then Gaoseng Terrace to review the palace guard Six Armies.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「車服以庸，古之制也；

translations.literal: An edict said: "Carriages and dress mark merit—such is ancient regulation;
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Carriages and dress mark merit—such was the ancient rule;

sentences.zh: 貴賤無別，罪莫大焉。

translations.literal: when noble and base are undistinguished, the offense is grave."
translations.idiomatic: when noble and base are undistinguished, the offense is grave."

sentences.zh: 應內外將相，許以銀飾鞍勒，其剌史都將內諸司使以降，只取用銅，冀定尊卑，永為條制。

translations.literal: Internal and external generals and chancellors were permitted silver-trimmed saddles and bridles; prefects, commanders, inner bureau commissioners, and those below might use only copper, to fix rank and make a lasting rule.
translations.idiomatic: Generals and chancellors within and without might use silver-trimmed saddles and bridles; prefects, commanders, inner commissioners, and those below were limited to copper, fixing rank for all time.

sentences.zh: 仍令執法官糾察之。

translations.literal: Enforcement officers were ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Enforcement officers were to investigate violations.

sentences.zh: 」《五代會要》載七月敕曰：祭祀之儀，有國大事，如聞官吏慢于恪恭，牲具禮容有異精審，宜令御史台疏其條件奏聞。

translations.literal: 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》 records a seventh-month edict: Sacrificial rites are great affairs of state; it is heard that officials are lax in reverence and offerings and ritual vessels differ from careful practice—let the Censorate list the particulars and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》 records a seventh-month edict: Sacrifice is a great affair of state; officials are said to be lax in reverence and offerings and ritual vessels careless—the Censorate was to list particulars and report.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以禪代已來，思求賢哲，乃下令搜訪牢籠之，期以好爵，待以優榮，各隨其材，咸使登用。

translations.literal: On guisi, since the transfer of the mandate, desiring worthy men, the Emperor issued an order to search and gather them, promising fine rank and generous honor, each according to talent, all to be employed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, since the founding of the dynasty, seeking worthy men, the Emperor ordered a broad search, promising fine rank and generous treatment, each employed according to talent.

sentences.zh: 宜令所在長吏，切加搜訪，每得其人，則疏姓名以聞。

translations.literal: Local magistrates were to search diligently; whenever such a person was found, his name was to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: Local magistrates were to search diligently and report each name found.

sentences.zh: 如在下位不能自振者，有司薦導之；

translations.literal: If one in low station could not advance on his own, the relevant offices were to recommend and guide him;
translations.idiomatic: Those in low station who could not advance on their own were to be recommended and guided;

sentences.zh: 如任使後顯立功勞，別加遷陟。

translations.literal: if after appointment he achieved merit in service, further promotion was to be granted separately.
translations.idiomatic: if after appointment he achieved merit, he was to be promoted further.

sentences.zh: 敕禁屠宰兩月。

translations.literal: Slaughter was forbidden for two months.
translations.idiomatic: Slaughter was forbidden for two months.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以高明門外繁台為講武台。

translations.literal: On jiawu Fantai outside Gaoming Gate was made the Drill Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Fantai outside Gaoming Gate was renamed the Drill Terrace.

sentences.zh: 是台西漢梁孝王之時，嘗按歌閱樂於此，當時因名曰吹台。

translations.literal: That terrace in Han times, when Prince Xiao of Liang, had held song and reviewed music here; it was then called the Terrace of Song.
translations.idiomatic: In Han times Prince Xiao of Liang had held song and reviewed music there; it was then called the Terrace of Song.

sentences.zh: 其後有繁氏居於其側，里人乃以姓呼之，時代綿寢，雖官吏亦從俗焉。

translations.literal: Later a family named Fan lived beside it, and neighbors called it by that surname; as ages passed even officials followed custom.
translations.idiomatic: Later a family named Fan settled beside it and neighbors called it by their name; in time even officials followed custom.

sentences.zh: 帝每登眺，搜乘訓戎，宰臣以是事奏而名之。

translations.literal: Whenever the Emperor ascended to gaze afar and review troops and train the army, the chief ministers memorialized on this matter and gave it the name.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the Emperor climbed it to review horses and train troops, the chief ministers memorialized on the matter and gave it the new name.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，敕應有暴露骸骨，各委差人埋瘞。

translations.literal: On xinhai in the eighth month an edict ordered that wherever exposed bones lay, agents were to bury them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the eighth month an edict ordered exposed bones buried wherever found.

sentences.zh: 兩浙錢鏐奏，請重鑄換諸州新印。

translations.literal: Qian Liu of the two Zhes reported, requesting recasting and exchange of new seals for the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu of the two Zhes asked to recast and exchange new seals for the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 詔禁戢諸軍節級兵士及供奉官受旨殿直以下各修禮敬。

translations.literal: An edict forbade soldiers of all armies, rank-and-file troops, and palace attendants from recipient edicts down to neglect ritual respect.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade soldiers of all armies, rank-and-file troops, and palace attendants of recipient rank and below to neglect ritual respect.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太史奏，壽星見於南方。

translations.literal: On jiayin the astrologers reported the longevity star appeared in the south.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the astrologers reported the longevity star in the south.

sentences.zh: 兩浙錢鏐奏，改管內紫極宮為真聖觀，改臨安縣廣義鄉為衣錦鄉。

translations.literal: Qian Liu of the two Zhes reported changing the Purple Pole Palace within his jurisdiction to the Abbey of the True Sage, and Guangyi Township of Lin'an County to Brocade Robe Township.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu of the two Zhes reported renaming the Purple Pole Palace within his circuit the Abbey of the True Sage and Guangyi Township of Lin'an Brocade Robe Township.

sentences.zh: 《十國春秋》、《吳越世家》：八月，梁敕封唐山縣為吳昌縣，唐興縣為天臺縣。

translations.literal: 《Spring and Autumn of the Ten States》、《House of Wu and Yue》 record: In the eighth month Liang edicts enfeoffed Tangshan County as Wuchang County and Tangxing County as Tiantai County.
translations.idiomatic: 《Spring and Autumn of the Ten States》 and 《House of Wu and Yue》 record that in the eighth month Liang edicts renamed Tangshan County Wuchang and Tangxing County Tiantai.

sentences.zh: 又敕升杭、越等州為大都督府。

translations.literal: Another edict promoted Hang, Yue, and other prefectures to great protectorates.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict promoted Hang, Yue, and other prefectures to great protectorates.

sentences.zh: 復改新城縣曰新登，長城縣曰長興，樂成曰樂清，避梁諱也。

translations.literal: Xincheng County was again named Xindeng, Changcheng Changxing, and Yuecheng Yueqing, avoiding Liang taboos.
translations.idiomatic: Xincheng was again named Xindeng, Changcheng Changxing, and Yuecheng Yueqing, avoiding Liang taboos.

sentences.zh: 甲子夜，東方有大流星，光明燭地，有聲如裂帛。

translations.literal: On jiazi night a great meteor appeared in the east, its light illuminating the ground, with a sound like tearing silk.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi night a great meteor blazed in the east, lighting the ground, with a sound like tearing silk.

sentences.zh: 唐州上言，白龍見，圖形以進。

translations.literal: Tang Prefecture reported a white dragon seen and submitted an illustration.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Prefecture reported a white dragon sighted and sent up an illustration.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，太原軍出陰地關南牧，寇掠郡縣，晉、絳有備。

translations.literal: On bingzi in the ninth month the Taiyuan army came out south of Yindi Pass to pasture and raided prefectures and counties; Jin and Jiang were on guard.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the ninth month the Taiyuan army drove south of Yindi Pass to pasture and raided prefectures and counties; Jin and Jiang were prepared.

sentences.zh: 帝慮諸將玩寇，乃下詔親議巡幸，命有司備行。

translations.literal: The Emperor feared the generals would grow lax toward the enemy and issued an edict to discuss a tour in person, ordering the relevant offices to prepare the journey.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing his generals would grow lax, the Emperor issued an edict to discuss a personal tour and ordered preparations made.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，翠華西狩，宰臣、翰林學士、崇政院使、金吾仗及諸司要切官皆扈從，余文武百官並在東京。

translations.literal: On dingchou the imperial carriage set out west on campaign; chief ministers, Hanlin academicians, Chongzheng commissioners, the Golden Guard, and critical bureaus accompanied; the rest of the civil and military officials remained at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the imperial train set out west; chief ministers, Hanlin academicians, Chongzheng commissioners, the Golden Guard, and critical bureaus accompanied; the rest of the establishment stayed at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，達洛陽。

translations.literal: On renchen he reached Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he reached Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 帝御文思殿受朝參，許、汝、孟、懷牧守來朝，澤州刺史劉重霸面陳破敵之策。

translations.literal: The Emperor took the throne at Wensi Hall to receive court; prefects of Xu, Ru, Meng, and Huai came to audience; Liu Zhongba, prefect of Ze, presented his plan to defeat the enemy face to face.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor held court at Wensi Hall; prefects of Xu, Ru, Meng, and Huai attended; Liu Zhongba, prefect of Ze, presented his plan to defeat the enemy in person.

sentences.zh: 癸未，西幸，宿新安。

translations.literal: On guiwei he set out west and lodged at Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he marched west and lodged at Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，至陝州駐蹕，蒲、雍、同、華牧守皆進鎧甲、騎馬、戈戟、食味、方物。

translations.literal: On bingxu he encamped at Shan Prefecture; prefects of Pu, Yong, Tong, and Hua all presented armor, horses, halberds and spears, delicacies, and local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he halted at Shan Prefecture; prefects of Pu, Yong, Tong, and Hua presented armor, horses, weapons, delicacies, and local tribute.

sentences.zh: 幽州都將康君紹等十人自蕃賊寨內來投，又幽州騎將高彥章八十人騎先在并州，乃于晉州軍前來降。

translations.literal: Ten commanders of Youzhou including Kang Junshao came over from within the barbarian camp; also eighty Youzhou cavalry under Gao Yanzhang, who had been at Bingzhou, came to surrender before the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Youzhou commanders including Kang Junshao defected from the barbarian camp; eighty Youzhou horsemen under Gao Yanzhang, who had been at Bingzhou, surrendered before the Jin army.

sentences.zh: 至是到行在，皆賜分物衣服，放歸本道，以示懷服。

translations.literal: When they reached the traveling court they were all given gifts of goods and clothing and sent back to their circuits to show appeasement.
translations.idiomatic: At the traveling court each received gifts of goods and clothing and was sent home to his circuit as a sign of conciliation.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，至陳州，賜宴扈從官。

translations.literal: On dinghai he reached Chen Prefecture and feasted the accompanying officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he reached Chen Prefecture and feasted the accompanying officials.

sentences.zh: 戊子，延州賊軍寇上平關，又太原軍攻平陽，烽火羽書，晝夜繼至。

translations.literal: On wuzi bandits of Yan Prefecture raided Shangping Pass, and the Taiyuan army attacked Pingyang; beacon fires and urgent dispatches arrived day and night.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Yan bandits raided Shangping Pass and the Taiyuan army attacked Pingyang; beacon fires and urgent dispatches arrived day and night.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，六軍統軍牛存節、黃文靖各領所部將士赴行在。

translations.literal: On yichou Niu Cunjie and Huang Wenjing, overall commanders of the Six Armies, each led their troops to the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Niu Cunjie and Huang Wenjing, commanders of the Six Armies, each led their troops to the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太原步騎數萬攻逼晉、絳，逾旬不克，知大軍至，乃自焚其寨，至夕而遁。

translations.literal: On jiawu tens of thousands of Taiyuan infantry and cavalry pressed Jin and Jiang; for more than ten days they could not take them; learning the great army had arrived, they burned their camps and fled by evening.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu tens of thousands of Taiyuan foot and horse pressed Jin and Jiang; after ten days without success, learning the main army had arrived, they burned their camps and fled by nightfall.

sentences.zh: 福州貢玳瑁琉璃犀象器，並珍玩、香藥、奇品、海味，色類良多，價累千萬。

translations.literal: Fuzhou presented tortoiseshell, glass, rhinoceros horn, and ivory vessels, together with curios, incense, rare goods, and seafood of many kinds, worth tens of millions in all.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou sent tortoiseshell, glass, rhinoceros horn, and ivory vessels, with curios, incense, rare goods, and seafood of many kinds worth tens of millions in all.

sentences.zh: 十月己亥，上在陝。

translations.literal: On jihai in the tenth month the Emperor was at Shan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the tenth month the Emperor was at Shan.

sentences.zh: 兩浙節度使奏，于常州東州鎮殺淮賊萬餘人，獲戰船一百二隻。

translations.literal: The military governor of the two Zhes reported that at Dongzhou Town in Chang Prefecture more than ten thousand Huai bandits were killed and one hundred two warships captured.
translations.idiomatic: The governor of the two Zhes reported killing over ten thousand Huai rebels at Dongzhou in Chang Prefecture and capturing one hundred two warships.

sentences.zh: 以行營左廂步軍指揮使賀瑰為左龍虎統軍，以左天武軍夾馬指揮使尹皓為輝州刺史，以右天武都頭韓瑭為神捷指揮使，左天武第三都頭胡賞為右神捷指揮使，仍賜帛有差，以解晉州圍之功也。

translations.literal: Campaign left-wing infantry commander He Gui was made commander of the Left Dragon-Tiger Army; Yin Hao, polo commander of the Left Heavenly Martial Army, was made prefect of Hui; Han Tang, chief of the Right Heavenly Martial Army, was made commander of the Divine Swift Army; Hu Shang, third chief of the Left Heavenly Martial Army, was made commander of the Right Divine Swift Army; silk was bestowed in varying amounts for the merit of relieving the siege of Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He Gui, left-wing infantry commander of the campaign, became commander of the Left Dragon-Tiger Army; Yin Hao, polo commander of the Left Heavenly Martial Army, became prefect of Hui; Han Tang, chief of the Right Heavenly Martial Army, became commander of the Divine Swift Army; Hu Shang, third chief of the Left Heavenly Martial Army, became commander of the Right Divine Swift Army; silk was granted in varying amounts for breaking the siege of Jin.

sentences.zh: 以尹皓部下五百人為神捷軍。

translations.literal: Five hundred men under Yin Hao were made the Divine Swift Army.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred men under Yin Hao were organized as the Divine Swift Army.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，禦內殿，宴宰臣扈從官共四十五人。

translations.literal: On yisi he took the inner hall and feasted forty-five chief ministers and accompanying officials.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he presided in the inner hall and feasted forty-five chief ministers and accompanying officials.

sentences.zh: 丙午，禦球場殿，宣夾馬都指揮使尹皓、韓瑭以下將士五百人，賜酒食。

translations.literal: On bingwu he took the ball-court hall, presented polo commander Yin Hao, Han Tang, and five hundred soldiers below them, and bestowed wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he took the ball-court hall, presented polo commander Yin Hao, Han Tang, and five hundred soldiers, and gave wine and food.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，至西都，禦文思殿。

translations.literal: On gengxu he reached the Western Capital and took Wensi Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he reached the Western Capital and took Wensi Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，宰臣百僚起居於殿前，遂宣赴內宴，賜方物有差。

translations.literal: On xinhai chief ministers and the hundred officials paid respects before the hall, then were summoned to an inner feast and given local products in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai chief ministers and officials paid respects before the hall, then were summoned to an inner feast and given gifts in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，至東都。

translations.literal: On dingsi he reached the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he reached the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 己未，大明節，諸道節度刺史各進獻鞍馬、銀器、綾帛以祝壽，宰臣百官設齋相國寺。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the Great Bright Festival, military governors and prefects of the circuits each presented saddles, horses, silver vessels, and silk to wish long life; chief ministers and officials held a fast at Xiangguo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the Great Bright Festival, circuit governors and prefects presented saddles, horses, silver, and silk for the Emperor's longevity; chief ministers and officials held a fast at Xiangguo Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，禦宣和殿，宴宰臣文武百官。

translations.literal: On renxu he took Xuanhe Hall and feasted chief ministers and civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he took Xuanhe Hall and feasted chief ministers and the full establishment.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，禦宣和殿，宴宰臣文武百官，以大駕還京故也。

translations.literal: On xinwei in the eleventh month he took Xuanhe Hall and feasted chief ministers and civil and military officials because the great carriage had returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the eleventh month he feasted chief ministers and officials at Xuanhe Hall to mark the return of the imperial train to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，禦宣和殿，宴宰臣文武百官。

translations.literal: On gengchen he took Xuanhe Hall and feasted chief ministers and civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he again feasted chief ministers and officials at Xuanhe Hall.

sentences.zh: 出開明門，登高僧台閱兵。

translations.literal: He went out Kaiming Gate and ascended Gaoseng Terrace to review troops.
translations.idiomatic: He went out Kaiming Gate and climbed Gaoseng Terrace to review troops.

sentences.zh: 諸道節度使、刺史各進賀冬田器、鞍馬、綾羅等。

translations.literal: Military governors and prefects of the circuits each presented winter-farming tools, saddles, horses, silk, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit governors and prefects each presented winter-farming tools, saddles, horses, silk, and the like.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜文武百官帛。

translations.literal: On wuzi he bestowed silk on civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he bestowed silk on civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 乙未，又宴宰臣文武百官于宣和殿。

translations.literal: On yiwei he again feasted chief ministers and civil and military officials at Xuanhe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he again feasted chief ministers and officials at Xuanhe Hall.

sentences.zh: 《通鑒》，癸巳，中書侍郎、同平章事張策以刑部尚書致仕，以左僕射楊涉同平章事。

translations.literal: 《Comprehensive Mirror》: On guisi Zhang Ce, vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor, retired as minister of justice; Yang She, left vice director of the Department of State, was made chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: 《Comprehensive Mirror》 records that on guisi Zhang Ce, vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor, retired as minister of justice; Yang She, left vice director of the Department of State, became chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 十二月，立二王三恪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the two former kings and three with reverence were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the two former kings and the three with reverence were installed.

sentences.zh: 南郊禮儀使狀：「伏以《詩》稱有客，《書》載虞賓，實因禪代之初，必行興繼之命。

translations.literal: The southern suburban rites commissioner memorialized: "We submit that the 《Odes》 speak of having guests and the 《Documents》 record the guest of Yu—truly at the beginning of an abdication in favor of a successor the mandate to continue the line must be carried out."
translations.idiomatic: The southern suburban rites commissioner reported: "The 《Odes》 speak of guests and the 《Documents》 record Yu's guest—at the founding of a new dynasty the mandate to continue the former line must be honored."

sentences.zh: 俾之助祭，式表推恩，兼垂恪敬之文，別示優崇之典。

translations.literal: To have them assist at sacrifice shows extending grace, and also displays texts of reverent respect, separately showing statutes of preferential honor."
translations.idiomatic: Having them assist at sacrifice extends grace, displays reverent ritual, and marks preferential honor."

sentences.zh: 征于歷代，襲用舊章。

translations.literal: Examining past dynasties, old regulations are followed.
translations.idiomatic: Past dynasties followed the old regulations.

sentences.zh: 謹按唐朝以後魏元氏子孫韓國公為三恪，以周宇文氏子孫為介國公，隋朝楊氏子孫為酅國公，為二王后。

translations.literal: We respectfully note that Tang made a descendant of Northern Wei's Yuan clan Duke of Han the three with reverence, a descendant of Zhou's Yuwen clan Duke of Jie, and a descendant of Sui's Yang clan Duke of Xi the two former kings.
translations.idiomatic: Tang made a Yuan descendant of Northern Wei Duke of Han the three with reverence, a Yuwen descendant of Zhou Duke of Jie, and a Yang descendant of Sui Duke of Xi one of the two former kings.

sentences.zh: 今伏以國家受禪，封唐朝子孫李肼為萊國公。

translations.literal: Now we submit that since the state received the mandate, Tang descendant Li Pin was enfeoffed Duke of Lai.
translations.idiomatic: Since the state received the mandate, Tang descendant Li Pin had been enfeoffed Duke of Lai.

sentences.zh: 今參詳合以介國公為三恪，酅國公、萊國公為二王后。

translations.literal: After review it is fitting that Duke of Jie be the three with reverence and Dukes of Xi and Lai the two former kings."
translations.idiomatic: After review Duke of Jie should be the three with reverence and Dukes of Xi and Lai the two former kings."

sentences.zh: 」《五代會要》：十二月，改左右天武為龍虎軍，左右龍虎為天武軍，左右天威為羽林軍，左右羽林為天威軍，左右英武為神武軍，左右神武為英武軍。

translations.literal: 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》: In the twelfth month the Left and Right Heavenly Martial were changed to Dragon-Tiger Armies, Left and Right Dragon-Tiger to Heavenly Martial Armies, Left and Right Heavenly Awe to Forest of Feathers Armies, Left and Right Forest of Feathers to Heavenly Awe Armies, Left and Right Heroic Martial to Divine Martial Armies, and Left and Right Divine Martial to Heroic Martial Armies.
translations.idiomatic: 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》 records that in the twelfth month the Left and Right Heavenly Martial became Dragon-Tiger Armies, Dragon-Tiger became Heavenly Martial, Heavenly Awe became Forest of Feathers, Forest of Feathers became Heavenly Awe, Heroic Martial became Divine Martial, and Divine Martial became Heroic Martial.

sentences.zh: 前朝置龍虎六軍謂之衛士，至是以天武、神武、英武等六軍易其軍號而任勳舊焉。

translations.literal: The former court had established the six Dragon-Tiger armies called guards; now the six armies Heavenly Martial, Divine Martial, Heroic Martial, and others exchanged designations and employed meritorious veterans.
translations.idiomatic: The former court's six Dragon-Tiger armies had been called guards; now Heavenly Martial, Divine Martial, Heroic Martial, and the other six armies exchanged names and placed meritorious veterans in command.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，獵畋於含耀門外。

translations.literal: On guichou he hunted outside Hanyao Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he hunted outside Hanyao Gate.

sentences.zh: 開平三年正月戊辰朔，帝御金祥殿，受宰臣、翰林學士稱賀，文武百官拜表於東上閣門。

translations.literal: On the first day wuchen of the first month of the third year of Kaiping, the Emperor took Jinxian Hall, received congratulations from chief ministers and Hanlin academicians, and civil and military officials submitted memorials at the East Upper Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, New Year's Day of Kaiping 3, the Emperor presided at Jinxian Hall while chief ministers and Hanlin academicians offered congratulations; civil and military officials submitted memorials at the East Upper Gate.

sentences.zh: 己巳，奉遷太廟四室神主赴西京，太常儀仗鼓吹導引齋車，文武百官奉辭于開明門外。

translations.literal: On jisi the spirit tablets of the four chambers of the Grand Ancestral Temple were escorted west; the Directorate of Sacrifices with ritual guards, drums, and music led the fasting carriage; civil and military officials took leave outside Kaiming Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the spirit tablets of the four ancestral chambers were escorted west; the Directorate of Sacrifices led with ritual guards, drums, and music; officials took leave outside Kaiming Gate.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，發東都，百官扈從，次中牟縣。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he departed the Eastern Capital; officials accompanied; he halted at Zhongmou County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he left the Eastern Capital with officials in attendance and halted at Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，次鄭州。

translations.literal: On yihai he halted at Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he halted at Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙子，次汜水縣，河南尹張宗奭、河陽節度使張歸霸並來朝。

translations.literal: On bingzi he halted at Sishui County; Zhang Zongshi, prefect of Henan, and Zhang Guiba, military governor of Heyang, both came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he halted at Sishui; Zhang Zongshi, prefect of Henan, and Zhang Guiba, governor of Heyang, both attended court.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，次偃師縣。

translations.literal: On wuyin he halted at Yanshi County.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he halted at Yanshi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，備法駕、六軍儀仗入西都。

translations.literal: On jimao the full imperial equipage and Six Army guards entered the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the full imperial equipage and Six Army guards entered the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 是日，禦文明殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: That day he took Civilization Hall to receive court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: That day he took Civilization Hall for court congratulations.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「近年以來，風俗未泰，兵革且繁，正月燃燈，廢停已久。

translations.literal: An edict said: "In recent years customs have not been at peace and warfare has been frequent; the first-month lantern festival has long been suspended."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "In recent years customs have not been at peace and war has been constant; the first-month lantern festival has long been suspended."

sentences.zh: 今屬創開鴻業，初建洛陽，方在上春，務達陽氣，宜以正月十四、十五、十六日夜，開坊市門，一任公私燃燈祈福。

translations.literal: Now, as we open a great enterprise and first establish Luoyang, in early spring we must let yang energy prevail; on the fourteenth, fifteenth, and sixteenth nights of the first month ward and market gates should open and public and private alike may light lamps and pray for blessing."
translations.idiomatic: Now, founding a great enterprise and establishing Luoyang, in early spring yang must prevail; on the fourteenth, fifteenth, and sixteenth nights of the first month ward gates should open and all may light lamps and pray."

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，親享太廟。

translations.literal: On gengyin he personally offered at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he offered at the Grand Ancestral Temple in person.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祀昊天上帝於園丘。

translations.literal: On xinmao he sacrificed to August Heaven on the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he sacrificed to August Heaven at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 是日，降雪盈尺，帝升壇而雪霽。

translations.literal: That day snow piled a foot deep; the Emperor ascended the altar and the snow cleared.
translations.idiomatic: That day snow lay a foot deep; the Emperor ascended the altar and the sky cleared.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，禦五鳳樓，宣制大赦天下。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete he took Five Phoenix Tower and proclaimed a general amnesty for all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites ended he took Five Phoenix Tower and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 賜南郊行事官禮儀使趙光逢以下分物。

translations.literal: He bestowed gifts on Zhao Guangfeng, rites commissioner for the southern suburban ceremony, and those below.
translations.idiomatic: He gave gifts to Zhao Guangfeng, rites commissioner for the southern suburban ceremony, and his staff.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上御文思殿宴群臣，賜金帛有差。

translations.literal: On jiawu the Emperor took Wensi Hall and feasted the ministers, bestowing gold and silk in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Emperor feasted ministers at Wensi Hall and gave gold and silk in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賜文武官帛有差。

translations.literal: On bingshen he bestowed silk on civil and military officials in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he bestowed silk on civil and military officials in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 命宣徽使王殷押絹一萬匹並茵褥幃帟二百六十件賜張宗奭。

translations.literal: He ordered Palace Commissioner Wang Yin to deliver ten thousand bolts of silk and two hundred sixty sets of mats, cushions, curtains, and canopies to Zhang Zongshi.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered palace commissioner Wang Yin to deliver ten thousand bolts of silk and two hundred sixty sets of bedding and hangings to Zhang Zongshi.

sentences.zh: 《歐陽史》：丙申，群臣上尊號曰睿文聖武廣孝皇帝。

translations.literal: 《History of Ouyang》: On bingshen the ministers offered the honorific title Emperor Sagely Cultured, Divinely Martial, and Broadly Filial.
translations.idiomatic: 《History of Ouyang》 records that on bingshen the ministers offered the honorific Emperor Sagely Cultured, Divinely Martial, and Broadly Filial.

sentences.zh: 改西京貞觀殿為文明殿，含元殿為朝元殿。

translations.literal: The Western Capital's Zhenguan Hall was renamed Civilization Hall and Hanyuan Hall Court Audience Hall.
translations.idiomatic: At the Western Capital Zhenguan Hall became Civilization Hall and Hanyuan Hall Court Audience Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月，改思政殿為金鑾殿。

translations.literal: In the second month Sizheng Hall was renamed Golden Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Sizheng Hall was renamed Golden Hall.

sentences.zh: 敕東都曰：「自升州作府，建邑為都，未廣邦畿，頗虧國體。

translations.literal: An edict to the Eastern Capital said: "Since Sheng Prefecture was made a fu and a capital city built, the metropolitan domain has not been broadened, which somewhat diminishes the dignity of the state."
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the Eastern Capital declared: "Since the prefecture was raised to a capital, the metropolitan domain has not been broadened, which diminishes the dignity of the state."

sentences.zh: 其以滑州酸棗縣長垣縣、鄭州中牟縣陽武縣、宋州襄邑縣、曹州戴邑縣、許州扶溝縣鄢陵縣、陳州太康縣等九縣，宜並割屬開封府，仍升為畿縣。

translations.literal: The nine counties of Suanzao and Changyuan in Hua Prefecture, Zhongmou and Yangwu in Zheng Prefecture, Xiangyi in Song Prefecture, Daiyi in Cao Prefecture, Fugou and Yanling in Xu Prefecture, and Taikang in Chen Prefecture should all be transferred to Kaifeng Prefecture and promoted to metropolitan counties."
translations.idiomatic: Nine counties—Suanzao and Changyuan in Hua, Zhongmou and Yangwu in Zheng, Xiangyi in Song, Daiyi in Cao, Fugou and Yanling in Xu, and Taikang in Chen—were to be transferred to Kaifeng Prefecture and raised to metropolitan counties.

sentences.zh: 」《輿地廣記》：硃梁時，楊氏據江、淮，於是吳越錢氏上言，以淮寇未平，恥聞逆姓，請改松陽縣為長松。

translations.literal: 《Broad Record of Geography》 records: In Zhu Liang times the Yang clan held the Jiang and Huai; then Qian of Wu and Yue memorialized that with Huai bandits not yet pacified they were ashamed to hear the rebel surname and asked to rename Songyang County Changsong.
translations.idiomatic: 《Broad Record of Geography》 records that under Zhu Liang the Yang clan held the Jiang and Huai; Qian of Wu and Yue then asked, with Huai rebels still active, to rename Songyang Changsong rather than hear the rebel surname.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宴群臣於崇勳殿。

translations.literal: On dingyou he feasted the ministers at Chongxun Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he feasted ministers at Chongxun Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，又宴群臣於崇勳殿，蓋籓臣進賀，勉而從之。

translations.literal: On jiachen he again feasted ministers at Chongxun Hall, because circuit ministers came to congratulate and he yielded to their urging.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he feasted ministers again at Chongxun Hall at the urging of congratulatory envoys from the circuits.

sentences.zh: 丙午，宗正寺請修興極、永安、光天、咸甯諸陵，並令添修上下宮殿、栽植松柏。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Court of the Imperial Clan requested repair of the tombs Xingji, Yong'an, Guangtian, and Xianning, and ordered upper and lower palace halls restored and pines and cypresses planted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Court of the Imperial Clan asked to repair the tombs Xingji, Yong'an, Guangtian, and Xianning and to restore palace halls and plant pines and cypresses.

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，敕：「豐沛之基，寢園所在，悽愴動關於情理，充奉自系于國章。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict said: "The foundation at Feng and Pei, the resting place of the imperial tombs—grief touches feeling and provision is bound to state law."
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict declared: "The foundation at Feng and Pei and the imperial tombs move the heart with grief and demand provision by state law."

sentences.zh: 宜設陵台，兼升縣望。

translations.literal: A tomb office should be established and the county's standing raised.
translations.idiomatic: A tomb office should be established and the county's standing raised.

sentences.zh: 其輝州碭山縣宜為赤縣，仍以本縣令兼四陵台令。

translations.literal: Dangshan County in Hui Prefecture should be a red county, and the county magistrate should also hold the four tomb offices."
translations.idiomatic: Dangshan in Hui Prefecture should be a red county, its magistrate also holding the four tomb offices."

sentences.zh: 」同州節度使劉知俊奏，延州都指揮使高萬興部領節級家累三十八人來降。

translations.literal: Liu Zhijun, military governor of Tongzhou, reported that Gao Wanxing, commander of Yan Prefecture, led thirty-eight officers and families of rank to surrender."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhijun, governor of Tongzhou, reported that Gao Wanxing, commander of Yan, led thirty-eight officers and families of rank to surrender."

sentences.zh: 三月，以萬興檢校司徒，為丹、延等州安撫、招討等使。

translations.literal: In the third month Wanxing was made acting minister of works and pacification and pacification commissioner of Dan, Yan, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Wanxing was made acting minister of works and pacification commissioner for Dan, Yan, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔曰：「同州邊隅，繼有士眾歸化。

translations.literal: On xinwei an edict said: "On the Tongzhou frontier soldiers and people have continued to submit."
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei an edict declared: "On the Tongzhou frontier soldiers and people have continued to submit."

sentences.zh: 暫思巡撫，兼要指揮，今幸蒲、陝，取九日進發。

translations.literal: I wish for the moment to tour and pacify and also to command; now I go to Pu and Shan and will set out in nine days."
translations.idiomatic: I wish to tour and pacify in person and to command; I now go to Pu and Shan and will set out in nine days."

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，車駕發西都，百官奉辭于師子門外。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the imperial carriage left the Western Capital; officials took leave outside Shizi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the imperial train left the Western Capital; officials took leave outside Shizi Gate.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，次陝州。

translations.literal: On dingchou he halted at Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he halted at Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己卯，次解縣。

translations.literal: On jimao he halted at Jie County.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he halted at Jie County.

sentences.zh: 河中節度使、冀王友謙來奉迎。

translations.literal: He Zhong, military governor of Hezhong and Prince of Ji, came to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: He Zhong, governor of Hezhong and Prince of Ji, came to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，至河中府。

translations.literal: On gengchen he reached Hezhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he reached Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 幸右軍舊杏園講武。

translations.literal: He visited the old apricot garden of the Right Army for military drill.
translations.idiomatic: He visited the Right Army's old apricot garden for military drill.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以朔方節度使、兼中書令韓遜為潁川王。

translations.literal: On bingxu Han Xun, military governor of Shuofang and concurrent chief councilor, was enfeoffed Prince of Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Han Xun, governor of Shuofang and concurrent chief councilor, was enfeoffed Prince of Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 遜本靈州牙校，唐末據本鎮，朝廷因而授以節鉞。

translations.literal: Xun had originally been a Lingzhou guards officer; at the end of Tang he held his command and the court therefore granted him the seal of command.
translations.idiomatic: Xun had been a guards officer of Lingzhou; at the end of Tang he held his command and the court granted him the seal of authority.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申朔，駐蹕河中。

translations.literal: On the first day bingshen of the fourth month he encamped at Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the first of the fourth month, he encamped at Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 壬寅辰時，駕巡於朝邑縣界焦黎店，冀王友謙及崇政內諸司使扈從，至申時回。

translations.literal: On renchen at the chen hour the carriage toured Jiaoli Shop on the border of Zhaoyi County; Prince of Ji He Zhong and inner palace commissioners accompanied; it returned at the shen hour.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen at dawn the Emperor toured Jiaoli Shop on the Zhaoyi border with Prince of Ji He Zhong and inner commissioners; he returned at dusk.

sentences.zh: 己亥，御前殿，宴宰臣及冀王友謙扈從官。

translations.literal: On jihai he took the front hall and feasted chief ministers and accompanying officials including Prince of Ji He Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he took the front hall and feasted chief ministers and Prince of Ji He Zhong's party.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，宴宰臣及扈從官於內殿。

translations.literal: On jiayin he feasted chief ministers and accompanying officials in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he feasted chief ministers and the accompanying party in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 制：易定節度使王處直進封北平王，福建節度使王審知封閩王，廣州節度使劉隱封南平王，同州節度使劉知俊封大彭郡王，山南東道節度使楊師厚封宏農郡王。

translations.literal: An edict: Wang Chuzhi, military governor of Yiding, was promoted to Prince of Beiping; Wang Shenzhi of Fujian was enfeoffed Prince of Min; Liu Yin of Guangzhou Prince of Nanping; Liu Zhijun of Tongzhou Prince of Dapeng; Yang Shihou of Shannan East Circuit Prince of Hongnong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chuzhi of Yiding was promoted Prince of Beiping; Wang Shenzhi of Fujian enfeoffed Prince of Min; Liu Yin of Guangzhou Prince of Nanping; Liu Zhijun of Tong Prince of Dapeng; Yang Shihou of Shannan East Prince of Hongnong.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑朔，朝，遂命宰臣及文武百官宴於內殿。

translations.literal: On the first day yichou of the fifth month there was court, and chief ministers and civil and military officials were ordered to feast in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the first of the fifth month, after court chief ministers and officials feasted in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 己卯，車駕至西京。

translations.literal: On jimao the imperial carriage reached the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the imperial train reached the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 癸未，禦崇勳殿，宴宰臣及文武官四品以上。

translations.literal: On guiwei he took Chongxun Hall and feasted chief ministers and civil and military officials of the fourth rank and above.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he feasted chief ministers and officials of the fourth rank and above at Chongxun Hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，復禦崇勳殿，宴宰臣文武官四品以上。

translations.literal: On jichou he again took Chongxun Hall and feasted chief ministers and civil and military officials of the fourth rank and above.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he again feasted chief ministers and officials of the fourth rank and above at Chongxun Hall.

sentences.zh: 升宋州為宣武軍節鎮，仍以亳、輝、潁為屬郡。

translations.literal: Song Prefecture was promoted to a Xuanwu Army command, with Bo, Hui, and Ying as subordinate prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Song Prefecture was raised to Xuanwu Army command with Bo, Hui, and Ying as subordinate prefectures.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，同州節度使劉知俊據本郡反，制令削奪劉知俊在身官爵，仍徵發諸軍，速令進討。

translations.literal: On gengxu Liu Zhijun, military governor of Tongzhou, rebelled and held his command; an edict stripped Liu Zhijun of all ranks and titles and mobilized all armies for swift attack.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Liu Zhijun, governor of Tongzhou, rebelled and held his command; an edict stripped him of rank and mobilized all armies to attack at once.

sentences.zh: 如有軍前將士，懷忠烈以知機，賊內朋徒，憤脅從而識變，便能梟夷逆豎，擒獲凶渠，務立殊功，當行厚賞。

translations.literal: If soldiers before the army cherish loyalty and know the moment, or accomplices within the rebels resent coercion and see the turn of fortune, and can behead the rebel chiefs and capture the ringleaders, establishing outstanding merit, generous reward will be given.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers who knew the moment and rebels who turned on their masters, beheading chiefs and capturing ringleaders, would receive generous reward for outstanding merit.

sentences.zh: 活捉得劉知俊者，賞錢一萬貫文，便授忠武軍節度使，並賜莊宅各一所；

translations.literal: Whoever captured Liu Zhijun alive would receive ten thousand strings of cash, be made military governor of Zhongwu, and receive an estate;
translations.idiomatic: Whoever took Liu Zhijun alive would receive ten thousand strings of cash, the post of governor of Zhongwu, and an estate;

sentences.zh: 如活捉得劉知浣者，賞錢一千貫文，便與除刺史，有官者超轉三階，無官者特授兵部尚書；

translations.literal: whoever captured Liu Zhihuan alive would receive one thousand strings of cash, be made prefect, with three ranks of promotion if already in office, or extraordinary appointment as minister of war if not;
translations.idiomatic: whoever took Liu Zhihuan alive would receive one thousand strings, a prefecture, three ranks of promotion if in office, or extraordinary appointment as minister of war if not;

sentences.zh: 如活捉得劉知俊骨肉及近上都將並梟送闕廷者，賞賜有差。

translations.literal: whoever captured Zhijun's kin and close commanders of the capital and sent their heads to court would receive rewards in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: whoever delivered Zhijun's kin and close commanders to court would be rewarded in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，駕至蒲、陝，文武百官於新安縣奉迎。

translations.literal: On xinhai the carriage reached Pu and Shan; civil and military officials welcomed him at Xin'an County.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the train reached Pu and Shan; officials welcomed him at Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 劉知俊弟內直右保勝指揮使知浣自洛奔至潼關，右龍虎軍十將張溫以上二十二人於潼關擒獲劉知浣，送至行在。

translations.literal: Liu Zhijun's younger brother Zhihuan, inner-palace commander of the Right Victorious Guard, fled from Luoyang to Tong Pass; Zhang Wen of the Right Dragon-Tiger Army and twenty-two officers above him captured Liu Zhihuan at Tong Pass and sent him to the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihuan, Liu Zhijun's brother and inner-palace commander of the Right Victorious Guard, fled from Luoyang to Tong Pass; Zhang Wen of the Right Dragon-Tiger Army and twenty-two officers captured him at Tong Pass and sent him to the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 敕：「劉知浣，逆黨之中最為頭角；

translations.literal: An edict: "Liu Zhihuan was the foremost horn of the rebel party;
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Liu Zhihuan was the sharpest horn of the rebel party;

sentences.zh: 龍虎軍，親兵之內實冠爪牙。

translations.literal: the Dragon-Tiger Army was truly the foremost fang among the personal troops."
translations.idiomatic: the Dragon-Tiger Army the foremost fang of the personal guard."

sentences.zh: 昨者攻取潼關，率先用命；

translations.literal: In taking Tong Pass they were first to obey the command;
translations.idiomatic: In taking Tong Pass they were first in obeying the command;

sentences.zh: 尋則擒獲知浣，最上立功。

translations.literal: Soon after they captured Zhihuan, achieving the highest merit.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after they captured Zhihuan—the highest merit of all.

sentences.zh: 頗壯軍威，將除國難。

translations.literal: Greatly strengthening army prestige, about to remove the national peril.
translations.idiomatic: They had greatly strengthened the army's prestige and were on the verge of ending the national crisis.

sentences.zh: 所懸賞格，便可支分，許賜官階，固須除授。

translations.literal: The posted rewards may be distributed; promised offices and ranks must indeed be granted.
translations.idiomatic: The posted rewards were to be paid out; promised offices and ranks were to be granted without delay.

sentences.zh: 但昨捉獲劉知浣是張溫等二十二人，一時向前，共立功效，其賞錢一千貫文數內，一百貫文與最先打倒劉知浣衙官李稠，四十三貫文與十將張溫，二十人各與錢四十二貫八百五十文。

translations.literal: But yesterday Liu Zhihuan was captured by Zhang Wen and twenty-one others who advanced together and shared the achievement; within the one thousand strings of cash reward, one hundred strings went to Li Chou, the yamen officer who first struck down Liu Zhihuan; forty-three strings to chief Zhang Wen; and the twenty others each forty-two strings eight hundred fifty cash.
translations.idiomatic: But Liu Zhihuan had been taken by Zhang Wen and twenty-one others acting together; of the one thousand strings promised, one hundred went to Li Chou, the officer who first struck him down; forty-three to chief Zhang Wen; and the other twenty received forty-two strings eight hundred fifty cash each.

sentences.zh: 立功敕命便授郡府，亦緣同時立功人數不少，所除刺史，難議偏頗。

translations.literal: The merit edict would grant a commandery, but because many had achieved merit at once, appointing one as prefect would be hard to justify without bias.
translations.idiomatic: The merit edict would have made one a prefect, but with so many sharing the deed, a single appointment would have been unfair.

sentences.zh: 宜令逐月共支給正刺史料錢二百貫文數內，十將張溫一人每月與十貫文，餘二十一人每月每人各分九貫文，仍起七月一日以後支給。

translations.literal: They should share monthly from the two hundred strings allotted to a full prefect: chief Zhang Wen ten strings a month, the other twenty-one nine strings each, beginning the first day of the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: They were to share monthly from the two hundred strings allotted a full prefect: Zhang Wen ten strings a month, the other twenty-one nine each, from the first day of the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 人與轉官職，仍勘名銜，分析申奏，當與施行。

translations.literal: Each man was to be promoted in office; names and titles were to be reviewed, analyzed, and memorialized for implementation."
translations.idiomatic: Each was to be promoted; names and titles were to be reviewed and memorialized for action."

sentences.zh: 」是月，知俊奔鳳翔，同州平。

translations.literal: That month Zhijun fled to Fengxiang and Tong Prefecture was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhijun fled to Fengxiang and Tong Prefecture was pacified.

sentences.zh: 七月乙丑，敕行宮將士陣歿者，咸令所在給槥櫝，津置歸鄉里。

translations.literal: On yichou in the seventh month an edict ordered that officers and soldiers of the traveling palace who died in battle should be given coffins where they fell and transport arranged to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the seventh month an edict ordered coffins for officers and men of the traveling palace who fell in battle and transport home to their districts.

sentences.zh: 戰卒聞之悉感涕。

translations.literal: Soldiers hearing this were all moved to tears.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers who heard it wept.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命宰臣楊涉赴西都，以孟秋享太廟。

translations.literal: On bingyin chief minister Yang She was sent to the Western Capital for the mid-autumn offering at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin chief minister Yang She was sent west for the mid-autumn offering at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 改章善門為左、右銀台門，其左、右銀台門卻改為左、右興善門。

translations.literal: Zhangshan Gate was renamed Left and Right Silver Terrace Gates, and the former Left and Right Silver Terrace Gates were renamed Left and Right Xingshan Gates.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangshan Gate became the Left and Right Silver Terrace Gates, and the former Silver Terrace Gates became the Left and Right Xingshan Gates.

sentences.zh: 敕：「大內皇牆使諸門，素來未得嚴謹，將令整肅，須示條章。

translations.literal: An edict: "The various gates of the inner imperial wall have never been strictly guarded; to tighten discipline regulations must be shown."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "The gates of the inner palace have never been strictly guarded; discipline requires clear rules."

sentences.zh: 宜令控鶴指揮，應于諸門各添差控鶴官兩人，守帖把門。

translations.literal: The Crane-Control command should add two crane-control officers at each gate to guard and hold the doors.
translations.idiomatic: The Crane-Control command was to post two officers at each gate to guard them.

sentences.zh: 其諸司使並諸司諸色人，並勒于左、右銀台門外下馬，不得將領行官一人輒入門裏。

translations.literal: Commissioners of all bureaus and personnel of all offices and ranks must dismount outside the Left and Right Silver Terrace Gates and may not let even one attendant enter within the gates.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau commissioners and all ranks must dismount outside the Silver Terrace Gates; not even one attendant might enter.

sentences.zh: 其逐日諸道奉進，客省使於千秋門外排當抗，勒控鶴官舁抬至內門前，准例令黃門殿直以下舁進，輒不得令諸色一人到千秋門內。

translations.literal: Daily tribute from the circuits was to be arranged outside Thousand Autumn Gate by the Reception Office; crane-control officers were to carry it to the inner gate, where eunuch attendants of recipient rank and below might carry it in as usual—no personnel of any rank might enter within Thousand Autumn Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Daily circuit tribute was to be arranged outside Thousand Autumn Gate; crane-control officers would carry it to the inner gate, where eunuchs of recipient rank and below might bring it in—no one else might pass inside Thousand Autumn Gate.

sentences.zh: 其興善門仍令長官關鎖，不用逐日開閉。

translations.literal: Xingshan Gate was still to be locked by its chief and not opened and closed daily."
translations.idiomatic: Xingshan Gate was to remain locked by its warden and not opened daily."

sentences.zh: 」是日，又敕：「皇牆大內，本尚深嚴，宮禁諸門，豈宜輕易。

translations.literal: That day another edict: "The inner imperial wall was meant to be deeply secure; palace gates should not be lightly passed."
translations.idiomatic: That day another edict: "The inner palace was meant to be deeply secure; its gates must not be lightly passed."

sentences.zh: 未當條制，交下因循，苟出入之無常，且公私之不便。

translations.literal: Without proper regulations, lax practice followed; if coming and going were irregular, public and private affairs alike suffered inconvenience.
translations.idiomatic: Without rules, lax practice followed; irregular passage harmed both public business and private convenience.

sentences.zh: 須加鈐轄，用戒門閭。

translations.literal: Control must be tightened to warn those at the gates.
translations.idiomatic: Control must be tightened to warn those at the gates.

sentences.zh: 宜令宣徽院使等切准此處分。

translations.literal: Palace commissioners and others must strictly follow this disposition."
translations.idiomatic: Palace commissioners were to enforce this strictly."

sentences.zh: 」進封幽州節度使河間郡王劉守光為燕王。

translations.literal: Liu Shouguang, military governor of Youzhou and Prince of Hejian, was advanced to Prince of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shouguang, governor of Youzhou and Prince of Hejian, was promoted to Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 《通鑒》：七月癸酉，帝發陝州。

translations.literal: 《Comprehensive Mirror》: On guiyou in the seventh month the Emperor left Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: 《Comprehensive Mirror》 records that on guiyou in the seventh month the Emperor left Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，至洛陽，寢疾。

translations.literal: On yihai he reached Luoyang and fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he reached Luoyang and fell ill.

sentences.zh: 己丑夕，寢殿棟折。

translations.literal: On the evening of jichou the rafters of the sleeping hall broke.
translations.idiomatic: On the evening of jichou the rafters of the sleeping hall broke.

sentences.zh: 詰旦，召近臣諸王視棟折之跡，帝慘然曰：「幾與卿等不相見。

translations.literal: At dawn he summoned close ministers and princes to view the broken rafters and said mournfully: "I nearly failed to see you again."
translations.idiomatic: At dawn he summoned close ministers and princes to see the broken rafters and said mournfully: "I nearly failed to see you again."

sentences.zh: 」君臣對泣久之。

translations.literal: Ruler and ministers wept together for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: Ruler and ministers wept together for a long time.

sentences.zh: 遂詔有司釋放禁人，從八月朔日後減膳，進素食，禁屠宰，避正殿，修佛事，以禳其咎。

translations.literal: He then ordered the relevant offices to release prisoners, reduce meals from the first day of the eighth month, eat vegetarian food, forbid slaughter, avoid the main hall, and perform Buddhist rites to expiate the omen.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered prisoners released, meals reduced from the first of the eighth month, vegetarian food, an end to slaughter, the main hall avoided, and Buddhist rites to avert the omen.

sentences.zh: 商州刺史李稠棄郡西奔，本州將吏以都牙校李玫權知州事。

translations.literal: Li Chou, prefect of Shang Prefecture, abandoned his command and fled west; the command's officers made chief Ya officer Li Mei acting prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chou, prefect of Shang, abandoned his post and fled west; local officers made chief Ya officer Li Mei acting prefect.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，以秋稼將登，霖雨特甚，命宰臣以下禱于社稷諸祠。

translations.literal: On jiawu in the eighth month, with autumn grain about to ripen and rains especially heavy, he ordered chief ministers and those below to pray at the altars of soil and grain and the various shrines.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the eighth month, with the harvest near and rains especially heavy, he ordered chief ministers and officials to pray at the altars of soil and grain and other shrines.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「封嶽告功，前王重事；

translations.literal: An edict said: "Reporting merit on the sacred peak was a weighty affair of former kings;
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Reporting merit on the sacred peak was weighty business of former kings;

sentences.zh: 祭天肆覲，有國恆規。

translations.literal: sacrificing to Heaven and holding court with the feudal lords was the constant rule of a state."
translations.idiomatic: sacrificing to Heaven and holding court with the feudal lords was the constant rule of every state."

sentences.zh: 朕以眇身，恭臨大寶，既功德未敷於天下，而災祥互降於城中。

translations.literal: I with my slight person respectfully face the great treasure; merit and virtue have not yet spread through the realm, yet omens and disasters alternate within the capital."
translations.idiomatic: I, slight in person, hold the great treasure; merit has not yet spread through the realm, yet omens and disasters alternate within the capital."

sentences.zh: 慮于告謝之儀，有缺齋虔之禮，爰修昭報，用契幽通。

translations.literal: Fearing the rites of announcement and thanksgiving lack full reverence, I repair the bright report to accord with the hidden communion."
