translations.idiomatic: Fearing the rites of thanksgiving lack full reverence, I repair the bright report to reach the hidden powers."

sentences.zh: 宜令中書侍郎、平章事于兢往東嶽祭拜禱祀訖聞奏。

translations.literal: Yu Jing, vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor, should go to the Eastern Peak to offer sacrifice and pray, and memorialize when complete."
translations.idiomatic: Yu Jing, vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor, was to go to the Eastern Peak to sacrifice and pray, then report when done."

sentences.zh: 」又敕：「朕以干戈尚熾，華夏未寧，宜循卑菲之言，用致雍熙之化。

translations.literal: Another edict: "With weapons still blazing and the central plain not yet at peace, I should follow humble words and bring about a flourishing age."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict: "With war still raging and the heartland not at peace, I should follow humble counsel and bring a flourishing age."

sentences.zh: 起八月一日，常朝不禦金鑾、崇勳兩殿，只於便殿聽政。

translations.literal: From the first day of the eighth month regular court will not be held at Golden Hall or Chongxun Hall; audience will be only at the side hall."
translations.idiomatic: From the first of the eighth month regular court would not be held at Golden Hall or Chongxun Hall; audience would be only at the side hall.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，制諸郡如有陣歿將士，仰逐都安存家屬，如有弟兄兒侄，便給與衣糧充役。

translations.literal: On xinhai an edict ordered that wherever commanderies had officers and soldiers who died in battle, their families were to be supported by their commands; if there were brothers, sons, or nephews, clothing and grain were to be given for service.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict ordered commands to support the families of fallen officers and men and to clothe and feed brothers, sons, or nephews for service.

sentences.zh: 贈故山東道節度使留後王玨太保，贈故同州觀察判官盧匪躬工部尚書。

translations.literal: The late Wang Jue, acting military governor of Shandong East Circuit, was posthumously made grand guardian; the late Lu Feigong, observation judge of Tongzhou, was posthumously made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: The late Wang Jue, acting governor of Shandong East, was posthumously made grand guardian; the late Lu Feigong, observation judge of Tong, minister of works.

sentences.zh: 玨，故河陽將，累以軍功為郡守，主留事於襄陽，為小將王求所殺。

translations.literal: Jue was a former Heyang general who repeatedly won military merit as prefect and held acting authority at Xiangyang, where he was killed by the junior officer Wang Qiu.
translations.idiomatic: Jue had been a Heyang general who rose through military merit to hold Xiangyang in acting authority, where junior officer Wang Qiu killed him.

sentences.zh: 匪躬嘗為劉知俊判官，知俊反，不偕行，為亂兵所害。

translations.literal: Feigong had been Liu Zhijun's judge; when Zhijun rebelled he would not go with him and was killed by mutinous soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Feigong had been Zhijun's judge; when Zhijun rebelled he refused to follow and was killed by mutinous soldiers.

sentences.zh: 敕：「建國之初，用兵未罷，諸道章表，皆系軍機，不欲滯留，用防緩急。

translations.literal: An edict: "At the founding of the state warfare has not ceased; memorials from the circuits all concern military affairs; they must not be delayed lest urgency suffer."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "At the founding of the state war has not ceased; circuit memorials concern military affairs and must not be delayed."

sentences.zh: 其諸道所有軍事申奏，宜令至右銀台門委客省畫時引進。

translations.literal: All military memorials from the circuits should be delivered at the Right Silver Terrace Gate to the Reception Office for immediate presentation."
translations.idiomatic: Military memorials from the circuits were to be delivered at the Right Silver Terrace Gate to the Reception Office for immediate presentation."

sentences.zh: 諸道公事，即依前四方館准例收接。

translations.literal: Routine business of the circuits should be received as before at the Four Directions Hall according to precedent."
translations.idiomatic: Routine circuit business was still to be received at the Four Directions Hall as before."

sentences.zh: 」司天臺奏：「今月二十七日平明前，東南丙上去山高三尺以來，老人星見，測在井宿十一度，其色光明闊大。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy reported: "Before dawn on the twenty-seventh of this month, southeast by bing, three feet up the mountain, the longevity star appeared, measured in the eleventh degree of the Well mansion, its color bright and broad."
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy reported that before dawn on the twenty-seventh the longevity star appeared southeast by bing, three feet up the slope, in the eleventh degree of the Well mansion, bright and broad.

sentences.zh: 」敕：「所在長吏放雜差役，兩稅外不得妄有科配。

translations.literal: An edict: "Local magistrates should release miscellaneous corvée labor; beyond the two tax levies there must be no arbitrary exactions."
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered local magistrates to release miscellaneous corvée and forbid arbitrary exactions beyond the two taxes.

sentences.zh: 自今後州縣府鎮，凡使命經過，若不執敕文券，並不得妄差人驢及取索一物已上。

translations.literal: Henceforth at prefectures, counties, fu, and commands, wherever envoys pass, if they do not hold edicts or warrants they must not press men, donkeys, or take even one item."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth prefectures, counties, and commands might not press men, donkeys, or take a single item from envoys lacking edicts or warrants.

sentences.zh: 又，今歲秋田，皆期大稔，仰所在切如條流本分納稅及加耗外，勿令更有科索。

translations.literal: Moreover this year's autumn fields all promise a great harvest; local authorities must strictly collect only the statutory tax and surcharge and must not levy further demands."
translations.idiomatic: This year's harvest promised abundance; local authorities must collect only statutory tax and surcharge and levy nothing more.

sentences.zh: 切戒所由人更不得於鄉村乞托擾人。」

translations.literal: Those in charge are strictly forbidden to beg or harass the villages."
translations.idiomatic: Agents were strictly forbidden to beg or harass the villages."

sentences.zh: 閏八月，襄陽叛將李洪差小將進表，帝示以含宏，特賜敕書慰諭。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month Li Hong, a rebel officer of Xiangyang, sent a junior officer with a memorial; the Emperor showed magnanimity and specially granted an edict of consolation.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month Li Hong, a rebel officer of Xiangyang, sent a junior officer with a memorial; the Emperor showed magnanimity and granted a consoling edict.

sentences.zh: 又制：「左馮背叛，元惡遁逃，如聞相濟之徒，多是脅從之輩，若能回心向國，轉禍全身，當與加恩，必不問罪。

translations.literal: Another edict: "Left Feng has rebelled and the chief villain has fled; it is heard that many who aided him were coerced; if they turn their hearts to the state and turn disaster to safety, grace will be added and guilt will not be asked."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict: "Left Feng has rebelled and the chief villain fled; many who aided him were coerced; if they turn to the state and trade disaster for safety, they will be shown grace and guilt will not be asked."

sentences.zh: 仍令同、華、雍等州切加招諭，如能梟斬溫韜，或以鎮寨歸化，必加厚賞，仍獎官班，兼委本界招復人戶，切加安存。

translations.literal: Tong, Hua, Yong, and other prefectures were to urge surrender; whoever beheaded Wen Tao or submitted a fortified camp would receive rich reward and office, and was entrusted to win back households and settle them."
translations.idiomatic: Tong, Hua, Yong, and other prefectures were to urge surrender; whoever beheaded Wen Tao or submitted a fort would receive rich reward and office and win back and settle the people."

sentences.zh: 」己卯，幸西苑觀稼。

translations.literal: On jimao he visited the Western Park to inspect the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he visited the Western Park to inspect the crops.
